children.value: > Fact From Story: In the indictment, the prosecutors allege that Bankman-Fried lied to FTX investors.
> > Fact From Story: Bankman-Fried’s defense can also introduce risks for people who dealt with him
> > > > Fact From Story: Any piece of evidence they want to introduce for those two purposes has to come into play in the trial. | Fact From Story
> > > > Commonsense Knowledge: The more evidence introduced in a court case, the more risks there are for people involved. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Fact From Story: Some of those investors may be called on to testify, which is not the kind of thing VC big shots generally enjoy — and which might create collateral damage for the industry.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: People generally do not want to incriminate themselves.
> Fact From Story: There may be testimony from lenders, venture capitalists, and customers in order to establish the basis for some charges.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Lying to investors is risky for people who dealt with the liar.
